tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background (Streamlit backgroundColor). Warm paper, never pure white.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs, the sidebar (Streamlit secondaryBackgroundColor is surface-sunk, not this).

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Wells inside cards: quote blocks, table headers, the tracker lanes, input fills.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card borders and dividers. Decorative only — never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, secondary buttons, unselected chips. 3:1 on surface and canvas in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on canvas, surface, surface-sunk and every *-soft tint.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, labels, source lines — on canvas, surface and surface-sunk (≥5.4:1).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Disabled text and placeholder hints only. Below 4.5:1 in light — never for information.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Tangerine. Fill of the primary button, the logo tile, the active nav marker. One primary button per view.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover and pressed fill.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Label text and icons on a brand fill (5.6:1 light, 7.1:1 dark). Never white on tangerine.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Tangerine as text: links, the '.ai' of the wordmark, active nav label — on canvas, surface, brand-soft.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Tangerine tint: selected chip fill, active nav row, celebratory moments (application sent).

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: The highlighter. Marks the exact words the AI used as evidence, inside quotes from the CV or the posting. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: ai
tokens.usage: Sky. The AI's own voice: 'Why' labels, explanation headers, the 'How we know' disclosure, focus ring. As text on surface, canvas, ai-soft.

tokens.name: ai-soft
tokens.usage: Background of AI explanation blocks and the question card header.

tokens.name: ai-line
tokens.usage: Border of AI explanation blocks (decorative, paired with the ai label).

tokens.name: go
tokens.usage: Verdict 'Apply' and requirement 'Met' — as text/glyph on surface, canvas, go-soft. Always with ✓ and a word.

tokens.name: go-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of the Apply chip and of met requirement rows' status pill.

tokens.name: go-fill
tokens.usage: Met segments in the requirement bar, go dots. A mark, 3:1+ on surface.

tokens.name: clarify
tokens.usage: Verdict 'Answer first' and requirement 'To confirm' — as text/glyph on surface, canvas, clarify-soft. Always with ? and a word.

tokens.name: clarify-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of the Answer-first chip, the question card, unconfirmed requirement pills.

tokens.name: clarify-fill
tokens.usage: To-confirm segments in the requirement bar, pending dots.

tokens.name: skip
tokens.usage: Verdict 'Not for now' and requirement 'Conflict' — deliberately calm slate, not red: deprioritised, never an error. Text on surface, canvas, skip-soft.

tokens.name: skip-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of the Not-for-now chip and conflict requirement pills.

tokens.name: skip-fill
tokens.usage: Conflict segments in the requirement bar.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset in the ground colour. Alias of ai (6:1 light, 8.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links. Alias of brand-ink.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Bricolage Grotesque — friendly, a little quirky. Headlines and big numerals only, never paragraphs.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Landing hero and onboarding step titles. One per screen.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Opportunity names on cards, section headings.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Recompute deltas and the priority number inside the meter. Tabular.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Figtree for everything the user reads and taps. Tabular numerals on.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: 3 applications fit the 5 hours you set for this week.
styles.usage: Subtitle under a page title; the question text in a question card.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: You built a DCF model for a €40M target — the posting asks for valuation work.
styles.usage: Default text: reasons, requirement text, descriptions.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body; list item titles.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Lazarde & Co. · Milan · closes in 6 days
styles.usage: Metadata lines, chip labels, button labels in dense rows.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows over groups. ink-muted, or ai for AI-voice labels.

groups.name: Machine
groups.note: Only inside the 'How we know' layer and source lines.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Field keys, model parameters, stored facts, citation anchors.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Glyph-to-label gap inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between chips; label-to-value.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside dense rows (requirement rows, tracker tiles).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between items in a card; st.columns gap 'small'.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding; between cards in a list.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Top of page to title; onboarding step spacing.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Landing sections only.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Monograms, status pills inside rows, inputs' inner elements.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, quote wells, tracker tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs, the question card.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, verdict chips, segmented bars.

shadow.note: One resting shadow for cards, one lifted shadow for dialogs and the card being recomputed.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting cards on canvas.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: st.dialog, popovers, the card that just recomputed (for 1.2s).
